messages:
Maya R.: quick heads-up — proposing a coordinated bump for api/runtime/console/sdk next week. aiming for branch cutoff Tue 2025-05-13 17:00 PT. need owners to ack compatibility and changelog entries. cc @Sam @Kevin
Sam L.: ack. I can own runtime bump. will run the nightly e2e and smoke tests Mon morning, should have signal by noon.
Kevin P.: I can take console + SDK. SDK has a small breaking change for auth headers (minor semver but need to call out in changelog).
Ciara: API team: we have one open PR touching response schema — planning to merge tomorrow if tests green. will add a deprecation note in CHANGELOG.
Sam L.: runtime note: quantization profiles changed — runtime image tag will be rtf:2025-05-10. patch bump only but perf diff needs to be communicated.
Maya R.: thanks. can everyone paste the exact bump command they plan to run so we can standardize? e.g. `./scripts/bump-version.sh --component=api --new=0.14.0`
Kevin P.: for console/sdk i'll run: `./scripts/bump-version.sh --component=console --new=0.14.0` and `./scripts/bump-version.sh --component=sdk --new=0.14.0` then open the cross-repo PRs.
Ciara: API: `./scripts/bump-version.sh --component=api --new=0.14.0` + i'll add a short blurb under docs/release-notes.md about the schema tweak.
Sam L.: runtime: `./scripts/bump-version.sh --component=runtime --new=0.14.0` then trigger canary with `make deploy-canary FAST=true`. I'll post canary results in this thread.
release-bot: reminder — branch-cutoff window opens in 48 hours for tag 0.14.0. See: https://go/internal/release-windows :bell:
Maya R.: plan for rollbacks: if runtime canary shows >2% tail latency, we revert runtime image and hold other bumps. can we agree?
Sam L.: agreed. I'll hold console/sdk merge until runtime canary stable or explicitly green-lighted.
Kevin P.: sounds good. I'll keep SDK behind feature-flag so runtime perf won't affect product rollout.
Ciara: merging API pr tomorrow morning; will ping here once changelog + docs update done.
Maya R.: perfect. final ask: please add your changelog snippet to the shared doc by EOD Monday so we can assemble the release notes. :thumbsup:
